svg.title: Mini-SGLang's processes and the sockets between them
svg.desc: Four boxes in a row: the client, the API server, a box for the tokenizer and the detokenizer, and a scheduler. Between each pair, one arrow runs to the right on the way in and one runs to the left on the way out. The client and the API server are joined by HTTP in and a server-sent event stream out, and the other pairs by ZeroMQ. The tokenizer and the detokenizer share one dashed box, because by default they are one process. Under the scheduler, a GPU box has an arrow down for the copy of the step's inputs and an arrow up for the copy of the sampled tokens.

g.text: copy down, launch, copy up: one turn of the scheduler's loop
